title: SLA Window
description: Optional service-level commitment. Absence means no commitment, not zero; duration predicates MUST also require presence. The default clock is elapsed, including weekends and non-working time, where P1D equals PT24H. A business clock counts only working time in the immutable business_calendar_id declaration from get_adcp_capabilities.business_calendars. Business durations MUST be converted to a deadline for the particular receipt time before comparison with elapsed commitments; P1D uses that calendar's business_day_minutes, not 24 hours. See the service commitments reference for clock and snapshot rules.

clock.description: Elapsed time by default. Business time counts only the referenced calendar's working periods, starting at receipt or the next working period if receipt is outside working time.

business_calendar_id.description: Immutable seller-local calendar identity. Required only with clock business and MUST resolve uniquely in get_adcp_capabilities.business_calendars. Changes require a new identity; pending requests retain their original calendar.

response_max.description: Maximum time under the selected clock until acknowledgement (synchronous response for self_serve, tolerance decision for conditional_self_serve, or queue acknowledgement for seller_managed and legacy requires_approval). Elapsed action commitments run from buyer issuance and include weekends and non-working periods. On creative review_sla this means receipt acknowledgement measured from seller receipt of the review submission. For report_media_buy_issue it means a human acknowledging the report, measured from seller receipt; an automated receipt does not satisfy it. ISO 8601 duration.

completion_max.description: Maximum time under the selected clock until completion (mutation applied, proposal finalized, or seller-managed decision resolved), measured from buyer issuance for elapsed action SLAs. On creative_policy.review_sla or an action's review_sla, completion is an approved or rejected review decision, measured from seller receipt of the review submission. On report_media_buy_issue it is resolution from seller receipt, never an additional duration after acknowledgement. ISO 8601 duration.

verifier_constraints.calendar_reference: A business_calendar_id resolves to exactly one immutable get_adcp_capabilities.business_calendars declaration whose coverage includes receipt and the computed deadline. Invalid or unresolved calendars never fall back to elapsed time.
verifier_constraints.request_snapshot: Pending requests retain the SLA and calendar resolved at receipt. Maxima are independent upper bounds; a completion maximum shorter than the response maximum does not invalidate either commitment.
